purpose: Structural revision for a close-inspected catalogue groundcover prop. Compare against immutable 2,418-triangle original. Preserve meter scale; form first; no surface maps in this iteration.

criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.
Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief.
Compare every diagnostic anatomical/botanical/geological feature with cited sources and label reconstruction uncertainty.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.

coverage_justification: 24 distinct azimuths plus all orthographic axes, clay with alternate key, actual triangulated wire and pinna–rachis crop. Original/revision share fixed world camera and framing.

subject.scale: artistic meters, original envelope about 1.44 x 1.52 x 0.80 m

intended_use.runtime: Three.js 0.180.0 static gallery; prospective repeated groundcover
intended_use.view_envelope: full plant 128–512 projected pixels; pinna-rachis detail 256 pixels
intended_use.performance_status: requires measured GPU and populated scene tests; this candidate alone does not establish population suitability

budget_rationale: The original 2,418 triangles under-resolves curves and pinna shoulders. A ceiling of 12,000 allows 7 continuous 17-section rachises and 169 swept 8-section thin solid blades, rather than one folded fan each. Actual usage is reported, not filled to a quota. Separate 1.4 MB GLB ceiling is diagnostic safety allowance, not a library-wide cap. Texture budget is zero because veins cannot repair structural defects.
feature_obligations: Continuous frond/stipe/rachis hierarchy from one low crown
Narrow pinnae attach to the main rachis and taper progressively, without arrow shoulders or a single abrupt tent fold
Three unequal height tiers and visible inter-frond windows; check the whole orbit for overlapping terminal tips
One modest unfurling crozier; no flowers or seeds
Palette and scale held close to the original so comparison isolates structural change
